title: Isolate the doctor landing test Git fixture from inherited repository environment
outcome: Isolate the doctor landing test Git fixture from inherited repository environment
acceptance: The doctor landing test Git helper clears inherited repository-local Git environment variables and sets a fixture ceiling, so init, add, commit and worktree fixture commands remain confined to their named scratch repositories.
A regression or bounded execution with inherited Git routing variables proves fixture setup succeeds within the scratch repository without affecting another checkout.

completion.summary: Isolated doctor test Git commands from inherited routing and format settings using a resolved fixture ceiling, with a hostile-environment regression proving fixture success and an unchanged victim checkout.
